description: The National Institute of Geophysics, Geodesy and Geography of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences runs a real-time data section on its website. The menu of that section lists earthquakes, air pollution, stratospheric ozone, the geomagnetic field, surface ozone, the state of the ionosphere, a geomagnetic forecast, UV radiation, forecasts, total electron content (TEC), the tide gauge network and the permanent GNSS network. The institute has departments of geophysics, geodesy, geography, seismology and seismic engineering and a centre for hydrology and water management, and it invites the public to report felt earthquakes through a questionnaire and to send requests for geo-services. Access to the pages is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Bulgarian, the page read gives the menu of products, not their archives, and data requests go through the institute. Coverage is Bulgaria. It supports hazard exposure analysis for earthquakes and for space weather effects on power grids, GNSS and HF communications, and sea level monitoring near ports; related records are the Tromsø Geophysical Observatory data and SCiESMEX of Mexico.
